{{Top|leg}}
The '''Master of the Grand Protector's Hunters' Guild''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] title denoting the leader of the [[Goa-Ato/Legends|Goa-Ato]], a tradition in which Rodians left their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] to [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] prey in the larger [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The title always belonged to the current Rodian [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]].
